sharedRules.name: Markerlight
sharedRules.description:
Each time you hit a unit with a marker light place a counter next to the unit. These counters remain until the end of the current Tau shooting phase. Other Tau units (and Vespid if the Strain Leader is alive) my use these counters. A unit may not use its own counters. When a unit targets a enemy unit it must declare how many counters will be used and for what effects before any hit rolls are made. The counters are removed after the attack is complete. Markerlights cannot be used by other markerlights. A counter may be expended for one of the following affects:
-A vehicle to fire a single seeker missile at the marked unit. The shooting is handled normally and resolved at BS 5
-A unit may increase its BS by +1 to a max of 5
-The unit automatically passes a Target Priority test when shooting a marked unit
-Ignore the night fighting rules when shooting the marked unit
-Impose a -1 leadership penalty on the marked unit for the purposes of any Pinning tests. This can be done multiple times with the modifier being cumulative. Note that double 1's on leadership always pass regardless of the penalty.
-Impose a -1 penalty on any cover saves the marked unit makes against this shooting attack. This can be done multiple times with the modifier being cumulative.
